title: Size of a permutation path prefix
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\pi$ be a permutation of $[n]$, and let $k$ be an integer with $0\le k\le n$. The set of indices $i$ for which the value $\pi(i)$ is less than $k$ has cardinality $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is represented by an element of $\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$
